rv.q: Riotously entertaining revival of Peter Quilter’s play about Florence Foster Jenkins hits all the right notes at Manchester’s Hope Mill Theatre
However, Peters drives through the creakiness with enough eccentric vim.
Wendi Peters is committed, convincing and courageous with her choices.
It's an evening of escapism, high tosh, and pure joy, with countless zingers, many of which are masterfully delivered by Charlie Hiscock’s droll accompanist Cosmé McMoon.
